en: The postcard features a hand-colored image of a traditional European house, surrounded by dense greenery and forest. The building has distinctive architectural elements like green shutters, red roof details, a decorated gable with antlers, and a wooden balcony. It appears to be set in a rural, possibly forested area. The text 'Forsthaus Rippoldsau.' is printed at the bottom, and there is a small vertical text line on the left edge mentioning 'Brück & Sohn Meissen. Handcolorirte Künstlerkarte.'
